“This must end for something else to begin.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): Death (Transformer). You are not annihilation. You are necessary ending, painful transition, and the force that cuts dead things loose so the living can survive.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype strengthens sacrifice, transition, and value recovered from collapse. Your Domain earns +10 Violence and +10 Culture marks each turn while you serve it.

  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Death (Transformer)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Religion and Intimidation.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Death (Transformer)

  • Strategic: Once per short rest of recovery, salvage, reform or post-catastrophe stabilisation, your Domain converts one failed or destroyed asset, initiative or position into a reduced but usable replacement (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Death (Transformer)

  • Tactical: You have advantage on checks against being frightened, and on checks related to corpses, endings, funerary rites, irreversible damage, or confronting what others cannot bear to face.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Death (Transformer)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Violence or Culture marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“You are called. You will answer.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): Judgment (Reckoner). You are final account, exposure, and the terrifying moment when evasion ends. You force consequences to arrive on time.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype strengthens revelation, decisive resolution, and moral or violent finality. Your Domain earns +10 Faith and +10 Violence marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Judgment (Reckoner)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Religion and Intimidation.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Judgment (Reckoner)

  • Strategic: Once per short rest of purge, revelation, judgment, exposure or final account, your Domain ignores the first major resistance, denial or concealment effect (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Judgment (Reckoner)

  • Tactical: You have advantage on checks against being charmed, and on checks made to detect lies, confessions, concealed guilt, or false repentance.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Judgment (Reckoner)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Faith or Violence marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“Balance is not discovered. It is enforced.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): Justice (Arbiter). You are legitimacy under pressure: law, accountability, and the dangerous idea that consequences should actually mean something.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype strengthens social order, reform, and conflict resolution. Your Domain earns +10 Diplomacy marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Justice (Arbiter)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Insight and Investigation.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Justice (Arbiter)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Diplomacy marks, it spends 20% less (never below 10).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Justice (Arbiter)

  • Tactical: You have advantage on checks against being charmed or frightened by creatures or effects attempting coercion, false authority, or magical compulsion.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Justice (Arbiter)

  • Strategic: Once per short rest of policy, trial, arbitration, reform or legitimacy, your Domain is made with advantage on its Domain rolls (the card fires it).

“Power is not rage. Power is what still obeys you after the world breaks.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): Strength (Warlord). Commander, breaker, disciplined engine of force. You do not merely hit hard — you make force coherent.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your Domain earns +10 Violence marks each turn while you serve it.

  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for the full tactical and strategic expression of battlefield command, violent pressure, and military dominance.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Strength (Warlord)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Intimidation and Athletics.

  • Strategic: Your Domain's Violence marks cap rises by 10.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Strength (Warlord)

  • Tactical: Your force of presence and battlefield authority begin to shape momentum.

  • Strategic: Once per Battle or Siege, your Domain adds +2 to one Strength Domain roll (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Strength (Warlord)

  • Tactical: When you make a Strength check, an Intimidation check, or a contested battlefield command check, you may treat any 2d10 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

  • Strategic: Your battlefield reliability increasingly shapes faction confidence, but its primary effect is expressed through your repeated competence at the table.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Strength (Warlord)

  • Tactical: Your mastery of force, discipline, and command places you among the most feared battlefield leaders of the age.

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Violence marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“Too much breaks. Too little fails. You are the line between.”

Temperance stabilizes extremes and converts volatility into control.

Domain edge: Your Domain earns +10 Logistics marks each turn while you serve it.

Tier 1 — Temperance

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Religion and Insight.
  • Strategic: Your Domain's Logistics marks cap rises by 20.

Tier 2 — Temperance

  • Strategic: Retain 1 overflow OP per turn.

Overflow Retention (Recovery: Passive (every turn) · Action: Auto) — Retain 1 overflow OP per turn that would otherwise be lost. No daily cap; reminder card only.

Tier 3 — Temperance

  • Tactical: Gain advantage vs Stress, poison, environmental effects.

Tier 4 — Temperance

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends from a channel that sits empty or at its cap, it spends 10 fewer marks (never below 10).

“Velocity is not speed. It is direction maintained under pressure.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Chariot (Squad Leader). Field commander, momentum-anchor, and small-unit tactician. You turn chaos into movement and movement into victory.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your Domain earns +10 Violence and +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for the full tactical and strategic expression of squad command, coordinated action, and breach momentum.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Chariot

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Piloting.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Chariot

  • Tactical: You gain 2 reliable NPC squadmates (typically using AC or Scout stat blocks).
  • Strategic: If a squadmate dies, your Domain replaces them during the next turn for 20 Non-Lethal marks (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Chariot

  • Tactical: You can use the Help action as a bonus action during combat, provided the target is an allied NPC or squadmate.
  • Strategic: Once per Siege or Bunker operation, you grant +2 to one Strength or Dexterity Domain roll (the card fires it).

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Chariot

  • Strategic: Once per Bunker Busters scene, your presence and squad let your Domain gain advantage on its Domain roll (the card fires it).

“Everything has a price. You just admit it.”

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Devil (Exploiter)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Stealth and Persuasion.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Devil (Exploiter)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Economy marks, it spends 20% less (never below 10).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Devil (Exploiter)

  • Tactical: When you make a Charisma or Intelligence check related to bargaining, coercive negotiation, blackmail, temptation, or leverage, you gain advantage.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Devil (Exploiter)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Economy marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“Order is not an idea. It is a budget, a road network, and somebody staying late to sign the papers.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Emperor (Administrator). Civic architect, system-builder, and keeper of functional continuity. You turn collapse into policy and policy into Athletics.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your Domain’s economy stretches farther around you. Your Domain earns +30 Economy marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for the full tactical and strategic expression of logistics, management, civic control, and state capacity.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Emperor

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Investigation and Persuasion.
  • Strategic: Your Domain's Economy marks cap increases by 3.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Emperor

  • Strategic: Each turn your Domain earns 10 extra Economy marks for every three hexes it holds (at least 10).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Emperor

  • Tactical: You have advantage on Intelligence checks related to logistics, trade routes, or deciphering bureaucracy. When searching for supplies in urban areas, you find twice as much as usual.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Emperor

  • Strategic: Once per Policy & Crisis Management scene, your Domain is made with advantage on its Domain rolls (the card fires it).

“If it lives, you are responsible for it.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Empress (Caretaker). You are abundance under pressure: not softness, but stewardship. You keep people, places, and fragile futures alive long enough to matter.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype nurtures resilience, relief, and sustainable flourishing. Your Domain earns +10 Culture and +10 Economy marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Empress (Caretaker)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Religion and Persuasion.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Empress (Caretaker)

  • Strategic: Each turn one controlled hex of your choice yields 10 extra Culture marks for your Domain.

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Empress (Caretaker)

  • Tactical: You have advantage on Wisdom checks related to healing, caretaking, Loyalty triage, or reading communal distress.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Empress (Caretaker)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Economy or Culture marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“You move before the map exists.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Fool (Catalyst). You are motion before certainty, risk before consensus, and the destabilizing force that turns unknown ground into lived reality.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype strengthens exploration, scouting, improvisation, and risky openings. Your Domain earns +10 Logistics and +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Fool (Catalyst)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Piloting.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Fool (Catalyst)

  • Strategic: Once per turn, on a travel, scouting, route-finding or first-contact leg, your Domain rerolls the first setback or complication (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Fool (Catalyst)

  • Tactical: When you make a Dexterity or Wisdom check related to movement, travel hazard response, scouting, or improvising under pressure, you gain advantage.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Fool (Catalyst)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Logistics or Intrigue marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“You understand cost.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Hanged Man. You gain power through sacrifice, inversion, and delay.

Domain edge: Your Domain earns +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Hanged Man

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Insight and Arcana. You learn the Resistance Tier-0 powers.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Hanged Man

  • Strategic: Once per turn, the first failed Intrigue or Soft Power action your Domain attempts returns 10 Intrigue marks instead of being a pure loss (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Hanged Man

  • Tactical: When you fail a check against being charmed, frightened, or restrained, you may immediately reroll it 1/long rest.

Reroll Failed Save (Recovery: 1/long rest · Action: Reaction (on failed save)) — When you fail a check vs. charmed / frightened / restrained, immediately reroll it.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Hanged Man

  • Strategic: Once per turn, after a failed raid, intrigue action, or diplomatic action, your Domain may immediately regain 1 spent OP of the type used and apply +1 to its next related strategic roll.

Sacrifice Refund (Recovery: 1/turn · Action: Strategic (after failed action)) — After a failed raid / intrigue / diplomatic action, regain 1 spent OP of the type used and apply +1 to the next related strategic roll.

“Leave me alone. I’ll return with something useful.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Hermit (Mystic-Isolator). You step away in order to see clearly. Solitude is not withdrawal to you. It is a forge, a lens, and a discipline.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype strengthens contemplation, covert preparation, and hidden spiritual leverage. Your Domain earns +10 Faith and +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Hermit (Mystic-Isolator)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Religion and Stealth.
  • Strategic: Your Domain's Faith marks cap and Intrigue marks cap rise by 10 each.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Hermit (Mystic-Isolator)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Faith or Intrigue marks, it spends 25% less (never below 10).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Hermit (Mystic-Isolator)

  • Tactical: When you are acting alone or without an adjacent ally, you have advantage on Wisdom checks related to perception, spiritual insight, or occult interpretation.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Hermit (Mystic-Isolator)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Faith or Intrigue marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“You speak for something bigger than yourself. Unfortunately, it has opinions.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): Hierophant. Spiritual leader and mediator between factions and the higher weirdness. You are part priest, part occult systems admin, part HR for gods and genii loci.

This Archetype means you’ve stood between people and the powers they invoked, and somehow not been turned into a cautionary tale. Yet.

Archetype Effects

  • Soft Power / Faith Hooks. This Archetype integrates you deeply with Bad Eden’s Soft Power and Tikkun systems. See the Hierophant Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for the full tactical and strategic details of your miracles, sermons, and extremely pointed blessings.

Domain edge: Your Domain earns +10 Soft Power and +10 Faith marks each turn while you serve it.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Hierophant (Tier 1)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Religion and Insight.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Hierophant

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Soft Power marks, it spends 20% less (never below 10).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Hierophant

  • Tactical: You have advantage on checks against effects caused by Qliphothic entities (Fiends, Aberrations) and effects related to the Darkness Track.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Hierophant

  • Strategic: Your spiritual authority aids Tikkun Olam: once per short rest, the marks cost or time to shift a hex's alignment toward a beneficial Sephirah drops by 20% (the card fires it).

“You already know. You just refuse to say it too early.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The High Priestess (Seer). You read the invisible pressure in a room before anyone else admits it exists. You are intuition weaponized, omen-bearing, and very difficult to surprise in ways that matter.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your archetype sharpens the faction’s hidden-state awareness and information leverage. Your Domain earns +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit; those are granted automatically by the Tier Engine at the appropriate character levels.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The High Priestess (Seer)

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Insight and Perception.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The High Priestess (Seer)

  • Strategic: Once per short rest of reconnaissance, espionage, omen-reading or hidden threat, your Domain's first successful information-gathering step reveals one additional hidden tag, threat or condition (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The High Priestess (Seer)

  • Tactical: When you make a Wisdom check related to reading motives, lies, omens, hidden influence, or intuition under pressure, you gain advantage.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The High Priestess (Seer)

  • Strategic: Once per short rest of prophecy, espionage, hidden threat, omen or clandestine revelation, your Domain is made with advantage on its Domain rolls (the card fires it).

“You are what you choose—and who you choose to stand with.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Lovers. Bonds define you. Commitment empowers you. Division weakens you.

Domain edge: Your Domain earns +10 Diplomacy marks each turn while you serve it.

Tier 1 — The Lovers

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Insight and Persuasion.

  • Strategic: Your Domain's Diplomacy marks cap rises by 20.

Tier 2 — The Lovers

  • Strategic: Once per short rest, the first coalition action your Domain shares gains +1 (the card fires it).

Tier 3 — The Lovers

  • Tactical: Gain advantage vs charm/fear near allies.

Tier 4 — The Lovers

  • Strategic: Once per short rest, your coalition rolls gain advantage and shed one coordination penalty (the card fires it).

“You do not wave your hands and hope. You know what symbols are for.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Magician (Scholar). Researcher, operator, and wielder of applied understanding. You turn knowledge into leverage and leverage into effect.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your Domain earns +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for the full tactical and strategic expression of scholarship, arcane literacy, research throughput, and recovered knowledge.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Magician

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Arcana and History.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Magician

  • Tactical: Your obsessive research habits begin to pay off in the metaphysical lab.
  • Strategic: Once per short rest of the Great Work's Identification phase, the time or resources needed to uncover the Lore of an assigned Spark are halved (the card fires it).

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Magician

  • Tactical: When you make an Intelligence check related to lore, magic, or old-world Lore, you can treat any 2d10 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
  • Strategic: Your deep knowledge increasingly guides faction decisions, but its main impact is felt through your reliable successes at the table.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Magician

  • Tactical: Your mastery of ancient and modern lore places you among the greatest scholars of the age.
  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Violence or Intrigue marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“You were never alone in your body.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Moon (Ancient Blood). You carry something older than law. Memory moves through you. It expects to matter.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your presence amplifies symbolism, inherited legitimacy, buried memory, and eerie cultural authority. Your Domain earns +10 Soft Power marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit; those are granted automatically by the Tier Engine at the appropriate character levels.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Moon

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in History.
  • Strategic: Your Domain's Soft Power marks cap rises by 20.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — The Moon

  • Strategic: Ancestral resonance steadies your hexes: your Domain adds +1 to its Soft Power Domain rolls.

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Moon

  • Tactical: You can cast Detect Thoughts 1/long rest without expending a powers slot and gain advantage on checks against being charmed.

Detect Thoughts (Recovery: 1/long rest · Action: Action) — Cast Detect Thoughts without expending a powers slot. (Permanent gain advantage vs. charm is passive.)

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Moon

  • Strategic: When your Domain achieves a Justice or Reformation outcome, the hex shifts one step toward Keter (Crown) or Tiferet (Harmony) (the card fires it).

“It is not over. That is not optimism. That is doctrine.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Star (Hopebringer). You are morale after catastrophe, the refusal to collapse, the dangerous force that makes people try again when the math says they should not.

Archetype Effects

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Star (Hopebringer)

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Star (Hopebringer)

  • Tactical: Allies within earshot who can see or hear you have advantage on checks against being frightened 1/long rest during a major scene or encounter.

Hopebringer Aura (Recovery: 1/long rest · Action: Action (during major scene)) — Allies within earshot who can see/hear you have advantage on checks vs. frightened.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Star (Hopebringer)

  • Strategic: After your Domain suffers a major setback, failed siege or catastrophic beat, the first recovery or rally scene before the next turn is made with advantage on its Domain rolls (the card fires it).

“People believe because you are visible.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Sun (Beacon). You are morale made public. Hope in daylight. Certainty others can gather around before the dark gets another vote.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Sun (Beacon)

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The Sun (Beacon)

  • Tactical: Allies within earshot who can see or hear you have advantage on checks against being frightened or charmed 1/long rest during a major scene or encounter.

Beacon Aura (Recovery: 1/long rest · Action: Action (during major scene)) — Allies within earshot who can see/hear you have advantage on checks vs. frightened or charmed.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The Sun (Beacon)

  • Strategic: Whenever your Domain spends Soft Power marks, it spends 30 fewer (never below 10).

“If it stands, it can fall.”

“You do not control chaos. You time it.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): Wheel of Fortune. You are variance and leverage.

Domain edge: Your Domain earns +10 Soft Power and +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.

Tier 1 (Level 1) — Wheel of Fortune

  • Tactical: You gain proficiency in Perception and Stealth. You learn the Guidance Tier-0 powers.
  • Strategic: Your Domain's Soft Power marks cap and Intrigue marks cap rise by 10 each.

Tier 2 (Level 5) — Wheel of Fortune

  • Strategic: Once per turn, after any random table roll, encounter roll, or variable-outcome result is revealed, your Domain may shift the result one step up or down the table, if a legal adjacent result exists.

Tilt the Table (Recovery: 1/turn · Action: Strategic (after roll reveal)) — After any random table / encounter / variable result reveal, shift one step up or down if a legal adjacent result exists.

Tier 3 (Level 11) — Wheel of Fortune

  • Tactical: 1/long rest, when you miss with an attack or fail an attribute check, you may treat the roll as a 10 before modifiers.

Treat as 10 (Recovery: 1/long rest · Action: Free (on miss / failed check)) — Treat the roll as a 10 before modifiers.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — Wheel of Fortune

  • Strategic: Once per turn, after an outcome is revealed on a Battle, campaign beat, travel encounter, or crisis table, your Domain may force a reroll or choose between the rolled outcome and the rerolled one.

Force the Reroll (Recovery: 1/turn · Action: Strategic (after outcome reveal)) — Force a reroll on a raid / beat / travel / crisis table, OR pick between rolled and rerolled outcome.

“Everything connects. Including you.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The World (Integrator). You see systems as wholes. Supply, ritual, morale, politics, travel, violence, myth — to you, these are not separate tracks, but one machine with many faces.

Archetype Effects

Tier 3 (Level 11) — The World (Integrator)

  • Tactical: When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check related to systems mapping, coordination, cross-domain analysis, or whole-pattern strategy, you gain advantage.

Tier 4 (Level 17) — The World (Integrator)
